new_standard.title: Methods for Stability Testing of Fork Lift Trucks
new_standard.scope: Specifies tilt-table test procedures and stability criteria for electric and internal combustion counterbalanced fork lift trucks up to 10,000 kg capacity.
new_standard.materials: Fabricated high-tensile steel mast and chassis, lead-acid / Li-ion battery, AC traction and hydraulic motors.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Longitudinal and lateral stability under rated load at maximum mast elevation, forward tilt, braking performance, overhead guard safety (falling object protection FOPS).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Zero vehicle tipping over on 4% to 18% slopes under full load; operator safety enclosure.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Tilt table stability test (Tests 1 to 4) per Clause 5, dynamic braking distance test per IS 7524.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 7 Material Handling Committee

mapping.evidence_source: Factories Act, 1948 (Lifting Machines Safety Rules); Directorate General of Factory Advice Service (DGFASLI)
mapping.evidence_excerpt: All industrial forklifts operated in registered factories must conform to stability and safety standards of IS 4357.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory factory safety standard for battery operated industrial forklifts.

Battery Operated Industrial Forklifts.investigation_notes: Formulated by MED 7. Mandatory under Factories Act safety rules.

mapping.evidence_source: Factories Act 1948; DGFASLI Safety Norms
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes stability and dynamic load testing for rough terrain and industrial forklift trucks.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory safety standard for diesel forklifts.

new_standard.title: Electric Traction Lifts: Part 1 Guidelines for Outline Dimensions of Passenger, Goods, Service and Hospital Lifts
new_standard.scope: Specifies outline dimensions, well hole, machine room, and structural safety requirements for electric traction goods elevators (Class A, B, C loading up to 5000 kg).
new_standard.materials: Structural steel guide rails, counterweights, traction hoisting machine, car frame with safety gear.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Rated load (2000 kg), speed, car platform area, door opening, progressive safety gear arrest under free-fall overspeed, overspeed governor tripping speed, buffer stroke.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Absolute passenger and freight safety; instantaneous emergency stopping if suspension ropes sever.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Overspeed governor trip test, safety gear drop test under 125% rated load, buffer impact test per IS 14665 (Part 2).
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 9 / State Lift Acts and Rules

mapping.evidence_source: State Lift and Escalator Acts (e.g. Maharashtra / Delhi / Karnataka Lift Rules); BIS MED 9
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Mandatory statutory compliance: Every industrial goods lift and hoist installed in India must obtain statutory license from the Lift Inspector conforming to IS 14665.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory elevator safety standard for industrial goods elevators.

Industrial Goods Elevators 2000 kg.investigation_notes: Formulated by MED 9. Enforced under State Lift Acts.

mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for hydraulic dock levellers.

new_standard.title: Hand-Operated Chain Pulley Blocks — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for hand-operated chain pulley blocks (spur gear / planetary gear type, working load limits 0.5 tonnes to 30 tonnes).
new_standard.materials: High tensile steel alloy load chain (Grade 80 / Grade T per IS 6216), forged alloy steel hooks (IS 8610), ratchet pawl brake with asbestos-free friction discs.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Proof load test (withstands 150% of rated working load limit), mechanical efficiency (effort on hand chain), automatic Weston-type load brake holding load indefinitely at any elevation without slipping, hook throat opening under overload.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Safe manual lifting in shipyards, power plants, and mines without load drop under sudden release of hand chain.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Static proof test at 1.5x WLL for 5 minutes, dynamic brake test at 1.25x WLL, hook deformation test.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 7 Material Handling Committee

mapping.evidence_source: Factories Act, 1948 (Section 29 Lifting Appliances); DGFASLI Safety Norms
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Mandatory statutory testing: All chain pulley blocks used in industrial premises must carry manufacturer proof test certificate conforming to IS 3832.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory lifting appliance safety standard for chain pulley blocks.

Heavy Duty Hand Chain Pulley Blocks.investigation_notes: Formulated by MED 7. Enforced under Section 29 of the Factories Act.

mapping.evidence_source: Factories Act 1948; DGFASLI
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes requirements for hand operated spur gear chain blocks.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory standard for manual chain pulley blocks.

new_standard.title: Electric Overhead Travelling Cranes and Gantry Cranes Other than Steel Works Cranes — Code of Practice
new_standard.scope: Provides rules for the structural, mechanical and electrical design, fabrication, and testing of electric overhead travelling (EOT) cranes (Class 1 to Class 4 duty).
new_standard.materials: Fabricated structural steel box girders (IS 2062), forged steel wheels, wire rope hoisting crab, electro-hydraulic thruster brakes.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Structural deflection (max 1/1000 of span under full load), safe working load (SWL 20 tonnes), proof load test (125% of SWL), factor of safety for wire ropes (min 5 to 7), mechanical gear design per IS 4460, electrical safety per IS 13947.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Fail-safe heavy industrial material handling in steel warehouses, turbine halls, and heavy machine shops.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Static deflection test, dynamic overload test at 1.25x SWL, non-destructive ultrasonic testing of butt welds.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 7 Material Handling Committee

mapping.evidence_source: Factories Act, 1948 (Section 29 Lifting Machinery); DGFASLI Crane Safety Rules
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Statutory mandate: EOT cranes must be designed and proof-tested per IS 3177 and certified by Competent Person every 12 months.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory engineering and safety code for electric overhead travelling cranes in India.

Overhead Double Girder EOT Cranes 20T.investigation_notes: Formulated by MED 7. Enforced under Factories Act Section 29.

new_standard.title: Automotive Vehicles — Portable Hydraulic Trolley and Bottle Jacks — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements and testing for portable hydraulic bottle jacks and garage trolley jacks (capacity 1 tonne to 50 tonnes).
new_standard.materials: Forged steel base and cylinder, hard-chrome plated piston ram, safety overload relief bypass valve.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Proof load test (withstands 150% rated capacity for 10 minutes without pressure drop), hydraulic oil leak tightness under load, minimum closed height and lift stroke, safety relief valve cracking pressure (110% to 125% rated load).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Zero vehicle drop or hydraulic seal blowout during heavy truck axle lifting.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Static overload test at 1.5x rated load, dynamic lifting test at 1.25x load, oil seal endurance test over 100 full cycles.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 7 Material Handling Committee

mapping.evidence_source: Automotive Industry Standard AIS-110; Central Motor Vehicles Rules (CMVR); DGFASLI
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Hydraulic jacks supplied as vehicle emergency tools or used in automotive workshops must comply with IS 4552.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory standard for automotive hydraulic bottle jacks.

mapping.evidence_source: BIS MED 7 Sectional Committee Specifications
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes hydraulic cylinder and safety bypass requirements for workshop hydraulic presses.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for hydraulic workshop presses.

new_standard.title: Indian Boiler Regulations, 1950 — Design, Construction and Inspection of Steam Boilers
new_standard.scope: Comprehensive statutory engineering regulations governing the design, materials, welded fabrication, safety fittings, and annual statutory inspection of steam boilers operating above 1.0 kg/cm2 pressure.
new_standard.materials: Boiler quality carbon steel plates (conforming to IS 2002 / SA 516 Gr 70), seamless carbon steel boiler tubes (IS 1914 / SA 210), forged steel fittings.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Design pressure, maximum allowable working pressure (MAWP), minimum shell and tube sheet thickness, hydraulic test pressure (1.5x MAWP), safety valve relieving capacity (min 100% maximum evaporative capacity), two independent water level indicators, low water level fuel trip.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Elimination of catastrophic steam boiler explosions in industrial processing plants.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Non-destructive radiographic examination of 100% longitudinal and circumferential welds, hydraulic pressure test witnessed by Chief Inspector of Boilers, safety valve accumulation test.
new_standard.source: Central Boilers Board (CBB) / Ministry of Commerce and Industry

mapping.evidence_source: Indian Boilers Act, 1923 (Section 6); Central Boilers Board Statutory Regulations
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Statutory Law: No steam boiler may be manufactured, imported, erected, or operated in India without formal approval of drawings, material certificates, and commissioning inspection under Indian Boiler Regulations (IBR 1950).
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory law and engineering standard for industrial boilers in India.

Biomass Fired Industrial Boilers.investigation_notes: Strictly regulated under the Indian Boilers Act, 1923 and IBR 1950.

mapping.evidence_source: Indian Boilers Act 1923; Central Boilers Board
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Statutory Law: Packaged oil and gas fired steam boilers must strictly comply with IBR 1950 standards and obtain statutory registration from Chief Inspector of Boilers.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory engineering standard for packaged oil and gas boilers.

mapping.evidence_source: Indian Boiler Regulations (IBR Chapter XIV Thermic Fluid Heaters); Factories Act
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Thermic fluid heaters operating with organic heat transfer fluids must conform to IBR safety standards and over-temperature safety cutoffs.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory standard for coil type thermic fluid heaters.

new_standard.title: Specification for Mild Steel Calorifiers
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for mild steel storage and non-storage calorifiers for central hot water supply systems in hospitals, hotels, and industrial buildings.
new_standard.materials: Fusion-welded mild steel shell with copper or stainless steel internal U-tube heating battery.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Design working pressure (up to 1.0 MPa), hydraulic test pressure (1.5x design pressure), shell corrosion allowance (min 1.5 mm), safety relief valve size, thermal heating efficiency.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Continuous hot water generation without shell rupture or galvanic tube corrosion.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Hydraulic pressure test per Clause 9, radiography of longitudinal welds, thermal output test.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 19 Thermal Engineering Committee

mapping.evidence_source: BIS MED 19 Sectional Committee Specifications; CPWD Mechanical Specifications
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes requirements for mild steel storage and non-storage calorifiers.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for calorifiers and thermal receivers.

new_standard.title: Shell and Tube Type Heat Exchangers — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies mechanical design, construction, materials, and testing of shell and tube heat exchangers (fixed tube sheet, U-tube, and floating head types) for chemical, refinery, and power engineering.
new_standard.materials: Carbon steel, low alloy steel, stainless steel, or copper-nickel alloys (aligned with TEMA Class R, C, B).
new_standard.technical_requirements: Shell diameter, tube pitch and layout (triangular or square), baffle cut and spacing, tube sheet thickness design per ASME Section VIII / TEMA, hydraulic test pressure (1.5x design pressure for shell and tube sides separately).
new_standard.performance_requirements: High thermal heat transfer coefficient; zero inter-fluid leakage between shell-side and tube-side process streams.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Hydrostatic test of shell and tubes, tube-to-tubesheet joint leak test with air-soap or helium mass spectrometry, dye penetrant inspection of weld overlays.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 19 Thermal Engineering Committee

mapping.evidence_source: BIS MED 19 Sectional Committee Specifications; Engineers India Limited (EIL) Standards
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes engineering design and mechanical fabrication standards for shell and tube heat exchangers.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national engineering standard for shell and tube heat exchangers.

Shell and Tube Industrial Heat Exchanger.investigation_notes: Formulated by MED 19. Aligned with TEMA standards.

mapping.evidence_source: BIS MED 19 Sectional Committee Specifications
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Specifies mechanical design and testing for surface condensers and shell-and-tube coolers.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for shell and tube condensers.

new_standard.title: Gasketed Plate Heat Exchangers — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for gasketed plate heat exchangers (PHE) used in chemical processing, dairy pasteurization, HVAC, and industrial cooling.
new_standard.materials: Corrugated stainless steel (SS304/SS316) or titanium plates, elastomeric gaskets (NBR, EPDM, Viton), heavy carbon steel frame with tightening bolts.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Design pressure (up to 2.5 MPa), operating temperature (-20°C to 180°C), herringbone chevron corrugation angle, gasket retention channel, hydraulic test pressure (1.3x to 1.5x design pressure).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Ultra-high thermal heat transfer efficiency (U-values up to 5000 W/m2.K) with close approach temperatures (down to 1°C); zero cross-contamination of streams.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Hydrostatic leak test of both channels simultaneously and independently, dye penetrant examination of deep-drawn plate pressings.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 19 Thermal Engineering Committee

mapping.evidence_source: BIS MED 19 Sectional Committee Specifications; Dairy and Food Engineering Guidelines
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes construction and performance requirements for gasketed plate heat exchangers.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for plate type heat exchangers.

mapping.evidence_source: BIS MED 19 Sectional Committee Specifications
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Specifies requirements for gasketed plate heat exchangers.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for gasketed plate heat exchangers.

new_standard.title: Design and Construction of Steel Chimneys — Code of Practice: Part 1 Mechanical Aspects
new_standard.scope: Specifies mechanical design, structural sizing, wind oscillation damping, and corrosion protection for self-supporting and guyed industrial steel chimneys and stacks.
new_standard.materials: Structural steel plates (IS 2062), internal refractory or borosilicate glass brick lining, external aerodynamic helical strakes.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Wind load computation, along-wind and cross-wind vortex shedding resonance response, seismic acceleration, foundation anchor bolt sizing, flue gas corrosion allowance, lightning protection.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Structural stability preventing aerodynamic fatigue collapse under high wind gusts; thermal resistance to corrosive flue gases.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Dynamic natural frequency calculation, radiographic inspection of shell butt welds, anchor bolt pull test.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 18 / CPCB Stack Height Regulations

mapping.evidence_excerpt: Mandatory structural design code for all industrial steel chimney stacks dispersing boiler and furnace emissions under Air Act.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory engineering standard for industrial steel chimneys and stacks.

Industrial Chimneys and Stacks.investigation_notes: Formulated by MED 18. Mandatory under environmental and factory safety laws.

new_standard.title: Technical Requirements for Rotodynamic Special Purpose Pumps
new_standard.scope: Specifies technical design, construction, materials, and performance testing for special-purpose centrifugal and multi-stage pumps (including high-pressure boiler feed pumps and chemical process pumps).
new_standard.materials: Cast carbon steel / stainless steel / 12% Cr steel casing and impellers, forged alloy steel shaft, mechanical cartridge seals.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Discharge pressure (up to 15 MPa), operating temperature (up to 200°C), NPSH required, minimum continuous stable flow, hydraulic balance drum/disc design, mechanical vibration severity per ISO 10816-3 (Zone A <= 2.8 mm/s).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Continuous cavitation-free injection of high-pressure feed water into steam boiler drums under fluctuating thermal loads.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Hydrostatic casing test at 1.5x maximum discharge pressure, 4-point pump performance hydraulic test per IS 9137 / ISO 9906, mechanical vibration survey.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 20 Pumps Sectional Committee

mapping.evidence_source: Indian Boiler Regulations (IBR 1950 Regulation 338 Feed Water Systems); BIS MED 20
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Boiler feed pumps must deliver 1.25 times maximum boiler evaporation rate at design boiler pressure and conform to IS 5120.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory engineering standard for high pressure boiler feed pumps.

Boiler Feed Water Pumps.investigation_notes: Formulated by MED 20. Enforced under IBR Regulation 338.

mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national engineering standard for chemical process pumps.

Chemical Process Pumps.investigation_notes: Formulated by MED 20. Equivalent to ISO 5199 / ISO 2858.

new_standard.title: Controlled Volume Metering Pumps — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies design, construction, and testing for reciprocating positive displacement controlled volume chemical metering pumps (plunger, hydraulic diaphragm, and mechanical diaphragm types).
new_standard.materials: PTFE / composite diaphragm, SS316, Hastelloy-C, or PVDF liquid head, ceramic ball check valves, micrometer stroke adjustment.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Flow metering accuracy (steady state accuracy +/- 1.0% over 10% to 100% flow range), linearity (+/- 3%), repeatability (+/- 3%), discharge pressure (up to 20 MPa), zero chemical leakage (double diaphragm with rupture sensor).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Micro-dosing of hazardous acids, alkalis, biocides, and boiler treatment chemicals without environmental leakage.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Steady state accuracy test across 5 stroke settings per Annex B, hydrostatic liquid end test at 1.5x design pressure.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 20 Pumps Committee

new_standard.title: Installation and Maintenance of Fire Fighting Pumps — Code of Practice
new_standard.scope: Specifies selection, installation, performance testing, and maintenance of stationary fire fighting pumps (horizontal split-case, end-suction, and vertical turbine booster pumps) for building fire protection.
new_standard.materials: Ductile iron / bronze casing, bronze impeller, stainless steel shaft, diesel engine / electric motor prime mover.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Rated flow (e.g. 2280 to 2850 l/min), rated head (min 0.7 MPa to 1.0 MPa), shut-off head (not exceeding 140% of rated head), delivery at 150% rated flow (min 65% of rated head), automatic start on pressure drop.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Guaranteed water delivery during emergency fire hydrant and sprinkler operation without cavitation.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Hydrostatic casing test, hydraulic performance curve test, automatic starting panel verification per NBC Part 4.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 22 / National Building Code of India (NBC)

mapping.evidence_source: National Building Code of India (NBC Part 4 Fire and Life Safety); State Fire Safety Acts
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Mandatory compliance with IS 15301 for fire fighting booster pumps installed in high-rise buildings and commercial complexes.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory fire safety standard for building fire fighting booster pumps.

Fire Fighting Booster Pumps.investigation_notes: Formulated by MED 22. Mandatory under NBC Part 4 and State Fire Force Acts.

new_standard.title: Specification for Liquid Ring Vacuum Pumps and Compressors
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements, testing, and performance for liquid ring (water ring) vacuum pumps used in paper mills, thermal power condensers, chemical distillation, and sugar manufacturing.
new_standard.materials: Cast iron / stainless steel 316 casing, eccentric rotor with radial forward-curved blades, mechanical seals.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Suction capacity (m3/h), ultimate vacuum (down to 33 mbar absolute with 15°C water sealant), power consumption, isothermal compression efficiency, capability to handle wet gas, condensable vapours, and carryover liquids without damage.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Explosion-proof isothermal gas compression without internal metallic contact; reliable vacuum priming.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Vacuum suction capacity test per Annex B using calibrated orifice plate, power measurement per IS 9137.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 20 Pumps Sectional Committee

new_standard.title: Submersible Sewage and Drainage Pumps — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for single-stage submersible centrifugal pumps driven by integral IP68 electric motors for pumping sewage, municipal wastewater, storm drainage, and sludge containing solids.
new_standard.materials: Cast iron Grade FG 200 / 260 casing, non-clog single or dual-vane vortex impeller, dual mechanical face seals in oil chamber.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Discharge flow (m3/h), total head, solid handling capability (spherical solids clearance min 50 mm to 100 mm without choking), motor insulation Class F/H, moisture ingress sensor.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Continuous non-clogging wastewater drainage in municipal sewage pumping stations and building basements.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Performance test per IS 9137, sphere passage test per Annex B, motor water tightness test at 0.3 MPa.

Sewage and Drainage Sump Pumps.investigation_notes: Formulated by MED 20. Enforced under municipal water supply and sewerage contracts.

new_standard.title: Solar Photovoltaic (SPV) Water Pumping Systems — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements and test procedures for standalone solar photovoltaic powered surface and submersible water pumping systems for irrigation and drinking water.
new_standard.materials: Monocrystalline/polycrystalline PV array, MPPT solar pump inverter controller, surface monobloc centrifugal / submersible pump.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Daily water output (litres/day per peak watt under 7.15 kWh/m2 solar insolation), wire-to-water system efficiency (min 45% to 55%), MPPT tracking efficiency (min 98%), dry run protection, remote monitoring telemetry.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Zero diesel fuel cost for farmers; automated solar pumping tracking daylight.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Outdoor dynamic testing on test rig under solar simulator per Annex B, water discharge measurement.

mapping.evidence_excerpt: All solar water pumping systems installed under PM-KUSUM DBT subsidies must strictly conform to IS 17018.

Solar Powered Surface Pumps.investigation_notes: Formulated jointly by MED 20 and ETD 28. Mandatory under MNRE PM-KUSUM scheme.

new_standard.title: Code of Practice for Testing of Positive Displacement Type Air Compressors and Exhausters
new_standard.scope: Specifies methods of acceptance testing and performance calculation for positive displacement air compressors (reciprocating, rotary screw, and rotary tooth).

new_standard.title: Pressure Reducing Valves for Domestic and Industrial Water Supply Systems — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for direct-acting spring-loaded and diaphragm-operated pressure reducing valves (PRVs) for building and industrial water piping.
new_standard.materials: Cast bronze or ductile iron body, stainless steel trim, EPDM reinforced fabric diaphragm, stainless steel control spring.

new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for concentric, double-offset, and triple-offset butterfly valves (wafer, lugged, and flanged types) for isolation and throttling.

new_standard.title: Sluice Valves for Water Works Purposes (50 to 1200 mm Size) — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for flanged cast iron and cast steel sluice gate valves, globe valves, and check valves for waterworks, industrial piping, and fire systems.
new_standard.materials: Cast steel / ductile iron body, stainless steel stem, bronze / stainless steel trim rings.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Nominal size (DN 50 to 1200), pressure rating (PN 10 to PN 16), seat leakage zero, torque on handwheel, clear waterway diameter.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Reliable long-term line isolation in cross-country municipal water transmission pipelines.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Hydrostatic body test at 1.5x PN, seat test at 1.0x PN, operating torque test per Annex B.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 17 / CPHEEO Manual

new_standard.title: General Purpose Ball Valves — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for full-bore and reduced-bore trunnion mounted and floating ball valves for oil, gas, petroleum, and general industrial pipelines.
new_standard.materials: Forged carbon steel A105 / cast steel WCB body, stainless steel ball supported by upper and lower trunnion bearings, spring-energized polymer seats (RPTFE / Devlon).
new_standard.technical_requirements: Pressure rating (Class 150 to Class 1500), double block and bleed (DBB) capability, emergency sealant injection ports, fire-safe design per API 6FA / ISO 10497, antistatic stem grounding.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Zero fugitive emissions and zero pipeline pressure leakage in cross-country high-pressure natural gas and crude oil pipelines.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Hydrostatic shell test at 1.5x rated pressure, high-pressure and low-pressure gas seat leakage test, fire-safe burn test.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 17 / PNGRB Pipeline Regulations

mapping.evidence_source: Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board (PNGRB) Technical Standards and Specifications; OISD-141
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Pipeline ball valves deployed in cross-country hydrocarbon networks must conform to IS 9890 / API 6D standards.

new_standard.title: Industrial Process Control Valves: Part 1 General Conditions
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements and testing for globe and rotary industrial process control valves actuated by electric motorized or pneumatic positioners responding to 4-20 mA analog control signals.
new_standard.materials: Cast carbon steel / stainless steel body, linear or equal-percentage trim, electric quarter-turn/linear servo actuator.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Flow coefficient (Cv), rangeability (min 30:1 to 50:1), hysteresis and deadband (max 0.5%), positioning linearity (+/- 1.0%), seat leakage class (ANSI/FCI 70-2 Class IV or VI bubble-tight).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Precise throttling control of chemical process fluid temperature, pressure, and flow in automated process plants.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Cv testing per IEC 60534-2-3, actuator response time test, seat leakage test per ANSI/FCI 70-2.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 17 Process Measurement Committee

mapping.evidence_source: BIS MED 17 Sectional Committee Specifications; ISA / IEC 60534 Aligned
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes testing and control characteristics for motorized process control valves.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for electric motorized process control valves.

new_standard.title: Pressure Relief Valves — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies design, construction, set pressure tolerances, relieving capacity, and testing of direct spring-loaded safety valves and relief valves for boilers and unfired pressure vessels.
new_standard.materials: Cast steel WCB / forged steel body, stainless steel nozzle and disc, alloy steel spring protected from process steam.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Set pressure tolerance (+/- 3% or +/- 0.15 bar), overpressure accumulation (max 10% of set pressure), blowdown reseating pressure (within 7% to 10% of set pressure), rated discharge capacity certification per IBR.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Ultimate mechanical overpressure protection preventing catastrophic vessel rupture under runaway thermal or pressure conditions.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Steam lift and capacity flow test at certified National Board / IBR flow test facility, seat tightness test with air/steam.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 17 / Central Boilers Board (IBR)

mapping.evidence_source: Indian Boiler Regulations, 1950 (Chapter III Safety Valves); SMPV Rules
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Statutory Law: Every boiler and pressure vessel must be fitted with at least two independent safety valves conforming to IBR and IS 3687.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory safety engineering standard for safety relief valves in India.

Safety Relief Valves for Boilers & Press.investigation_notes: Formulated by MED 17. Mandatory under IBR and SMPV Rules.

new_standard.title: Industrial Steam Traps — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements and performance tests for thermodynamic disc, inverted bucket, and thermostatic steam traps used in steam distribution piping.
new_standard.materials: Forged carbon steel or stainless steel body, hardened stainless steel disc/bucket, integrated strainer screen.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Maximum allowable pressure (up to 4.2 MPa), operating pressure range, condensate discharge capacity (kg/h), steam loss rate (live steam loss < 0.5% of capacity), resistance to water hammer and superheat.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Automatic discharge of condensed water and non-condensable air without losing valuable live steam in industrial plants.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Condensate discharge capacity test per Annex B, steam loss test per ISO 7842, hydrostatic shell test.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 17 Steam Equipment Committee

mapping.evidence_source: BIS MED 17 Sectional Committee Specifications; IBR Steam Piping Norms
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes design and steam loss measurement for industrial steam traps.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for thermodynamic and mechanical steam traps.

new_standard.title: Rolling Bearings — Boundary Dimensions — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies boundary dimensions, radial clearances, and tolerances for radial rolling bearings (including cylindrical roller bearings NU, NJ, NUP series and deep groove ball bearings).
new_standard.materials: High carbon chromium bearing steel (100Cr6 / SAE 52100 conforming to IS 4398), machined brass or pressed steel cage.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Dimensional tolerances (Normal, P6, P5), radial internal clearance (C2, Normal, C3, C4), basic dynamic load rating (Cr), basic static load rating (C0r), rotating run-out accuracy.
new_standard.performance_requirements: High radial load capacity and high speed performance in electric traction motors, gearboxes, and vibrating screens.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Dimensional inspection per IS 6455, radial clearance measurement per ISO 5753, life rating testing per IS 3824.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 6 Rolling Bearings Committee

new_standard.title: Rolling Bearings — Tapered Roller Bearings — Metric Series — Boundary Dimensions
new_standard.scope: Specifies boundary dimensions, contact angles, and sub-unit interchangeability for single-row metric tapered roller bearings (302, 303, 320, 322, 323 series) for automotive wheel hubs and industrial gearboxes.
new_standard.materials: Case carburized alloy steel or high carbon chromium bearing steel (100Cr6).
new_standard.technical_requirements: Cone bore, cup outside diameter, width, contact angle (10° to 30°), dynamic radial load rating (Cr), dynamic axial load rating (Ca), run-out tolerances.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Simultaneous transmission of high radial and thrust loads; rigid shaft preloading.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Dimensional inspection per IS 7460, radial and axial runout check per ISO 492.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 6 Rolling Bearings Committee

new_standard.title: V-Belts — Endless V-Belts for Industrial Power Transmission: Part 1 Classic and Narrow (Wedge) Belts — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies dimensions, pitch lengths, and power ratings for classical (A, B, C, D, E) and narrow wedge (SPZ, SPA, SPB, SPC) endless industrial V-belts.
new_standard.materials: Chloroprene rubber or EPDM compound reinforced with high-tenacity polyester tension cords and bias-cut rubberized fabric jacket.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Pitch width, pitch length tolerances, matching set limits, power rating per belt (kW), antistatic electrical conductivity per ISO 1813, oil and heat resistance.
new_standard.performance_requirements: High power transmission efficiency (> 95%) without cord stretch or slip in industrial motor drives.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Pitch length measurement on measuring pulleys under proof tension, electrical resistance test per ISO 1813, dynamic flex fatigue test.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 6 Machine Elements Committee

mapping.evidence_source: BIS MED 6 Sectional Committee Specifications; ISO 4184 Aligned
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes dimensional and power transmission requirements for industrial endless V-belts.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for classic and wedge industrial V-belts.

new_standard.title: Flexible Couplings — Dimensions and Performance Requirements
new_standard.scope: Specifies dimensions, torque ratings, and misalignment capacities for curved-tooth crowned gear couplings, pin-bush couplings, and flexible jaw couplings.
new_standard.materials: Forged alloy steel hubs and sleeve with precision induction-hardened crowned external and internal involute gear teeth, O-ring grease seals.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Nominal torque rating (kNm), maximum permissible angular misalignment (up to 1.5 degrees per gear mesh), axial end float, tooth surface hardness (min 50 HRC).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Transmits extreme mechanical torques with torsional rigidity while accommodating thermal shaft expansion and angular misalignment in rolling mills and heavy turbine drives.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Tooth profile inspection per IS 2284, static torque proof test, balancing test per ISO 1940 Grade G6.3.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 6 Machine Elements Committee

mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for flexible jaw couplings.

new_standard.title: Code of Practice for Selection of Standard Industrial Gear Units
new_standard.scope: Provides rating formulas, service factors, and selection guidelines for helical, spur, bevel, and bevel-helical speed reduction gear units.
new_standard.materials: Cast iron or fabricated steel gear casing, case-carburized and ground alloy steel gears (17CrNiMo6), taper roller bearing supports.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Thermal power rating, mechanical power rating, gear tooth pitting resistance per IS 4460, tooth bending strength, lubrication system, oil temperature rise (max 50°C above ambient).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Smooth silent power transmission with efficiency > 96% in cement kilns, conveyors, and mining drives.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Full load continuous run test, sound level measurement (max 85 dBA at 1 m), oil leak check.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 6 Machine Elements Committee

mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes selection and power rating code for enclosed industrial gear reduction units.

new_standard.title: Short-Pitch Transmission Precision Roller Chains and Chain Wheels — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies dimensions, tolerances, measuring loads, and minimum tensile breaking strengths for short-pitch precision roller chains (ISO / BS and ANSI series 06B to 32B, 40 to 160).
new_standard.materials: Heat-treated alloy steel link plates, case-hardened round pins, seamless bush and shot-peened hardened rollers.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Pitch, inner width, roller diameter, pin diameter, minimum tensile breaking load (e.g. 16B-1 min 60 kN), dynamic fatigue endurance limit, pre-loading proof load (1/3 of minimum breaking load).
new_standard.performance_requirements: High fatigue strength under pulsating loads in industrial conveyor drives, motorcycle final drives, and agricultural machinery.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Tensile breaking strength test per Annex B, length measurement under measuring load, dynamic fatigue test per ISO 15654.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 6 Machine Elements Committee

new_standard.title: Refillable Seamless Steel Gas Cylinders — Specification: Part 2 Quenched and Tempered Steel Cylinders with Tensile Strength Less Than 1100 MPa
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for seamless quenched and tempered steel gas cylinders (water capacity 0.5 litres to 150 litres) for industrial gases (nitrogen, argon, hydrogen) and medical oxygen.
new_standard.materials: High strength alloy steel (chromium-molybdenum 34CrMo4) manufactured by hot forging/billet piercing.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Test pressure (250 to 300 bar), working pressure (150 to 200 bar), minimum wall thickness, flattening test without cracking, hydraulic burst test (burst pressure >= 1.6x test pressure), Charpy V-notch impact toughness at -20°C and -50°C (min 35 J).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Absolute containment of high-pressure compressed gases without catastrophic ductile rupture or brittle fragmentation.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Hydraulic volumetric expansion test (permanent expansion < 10% of total expansion), ultrasonic inspection of 100% cylinder wall for laminations, mechanical burst test per Annex B.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 16 / Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organization (PESO)

mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory safety standard for seamless steel gas cylinders in India.

new_standard.title: Cylinders for the On-Board Storage of Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) as a Fuel for Automotive Vehicles — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for lightweight seamless steel gas cylinders (CNG-1 type) permanently installed on automotive vehicles for on-board compressed natural gas storage at 200 bar.
new_standard.materials: Chromium-molybdenum high strength alloy steel quenched and tempered.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Working pressure (200 bar at 15°C), hydraulic test pressure (300 bar), minimum burst pressure (min 450 bar), bonfire fire test (must vent safely through PRD without exploding), penetration bullet test, ambient temperature pressure cycling (15,000 cycles without failure).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Crash and fire safety of on-board vehicle CNG fuel cylinders under severe road collision scenarios.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Hydraulic fatigue cycle test, bonfire engulfment test per Annex C, ultrasonic examination.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 16 / PESO / CMVR Rule 115B

mapping.evidence_source: PESO Gas Cylinder Rules 2016; Central Motor Vehicles Rules (CMVR Rule 115B)

mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory automotive gas cylinder standard for CNG on-board vehicle cylinders.

Seamless Steel Gas Cylinders for CNG.investigation_notes: Formulated by MED 16. Enforced under PESO and CMVR.

new_standard.title: Transportable Vacuum Insulated Cryogenic Vessels — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for transportable vacuum-insulated double-walled stainless steel cryogenic cylinders (Dewars) for liquid oxygen, nitrogen, and argon at -196°C.
new_standard.materials: Inner pressure vessel and outer jacket made of austenitic stainless steel (SS304/SS304L) with multi-layer super-insulation (MLI) under high vacuum.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Working pressure (up to 2.4 MPa), vacuum level (< 10^-3 mbar), daily evaporation loss rate (max 1.5% to 2.0% per day for LOX), dual safety relief valves, bursting disc.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Safe storage and hospital supply of liquid medical oxygen with zero thermal loss or vacuum degradation.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Helium mass spectrometer vacuum leak test, cryogenic cold thermal shock test at -196°C, evaporation rate test.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 16 / PESO

mapping.evidence_source: Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organization (PESO) Static and Mobile Pressure Vessels Rules (SMPV)
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Compulsory PESO approval and BIS Scheme-I ISI marking for all transportable vacuum-insulated cryogenic liquid cylinders conforming to IS 16104.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory safety standard for transportable cryogenic liquid cylinders in India.

Welded Stainless Steel Cryogenic Liquid.investigation_notes: Formulated by MED 16. Governed under PESO SMPV Rules.

new_standard.title: Code for Unfired Pressure Vessels
new_standard.scope: Comprehensive national code for design, material selection, welded fabrication, non-destructive testing, and inspection of unfired cylindrical and spherical pressure vessels.
new_standard.materials: Carbon steel (IS 2002 / IS 2062), low-alloy steel, stainless steel.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Design pressure, maximum allowable stress, shell and dished head (torispherical, ellipsoidal, hemispherical) thickness formulas, nozzle reinforcement compensation, welded joint efficiency factor, post-weld heat treatment (PWHT), hydrostatic test pressure (1.3x to 1.5x design pressure).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Structural pressure integrity preventing catastrophic explosive vessel failure in chemical, refinery, and compressed gas plants.
new_standard.testing_requirements: 100% radiographic examination of Category A and B butt welds per IS 1182, hydrostatic test witnessing by third-party inspecting agency.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 18 Pressure Vessels Committee

mapping.evidence_excerpt: Statutory Law under Section 31 Factories Act and PESO SMPV Rules: Pressure vessels operating above atmospheric pressure must be designed, fabricated and tested in accordance with IS 2825.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory engineering code for unfired pressure vessels in India.

Unfired Fusion Welded Pressure Vessels.investigation_notes: Formulated by MED 18. Mandatory under Section 31 Factories Act and PESO SMPV Rules.

new_standard.title: Specification for Hand Operated Torque Wrenches
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements and calibration procedures for hand-operated torque wrenches (click type mechanical, dial type, and electronic digital types) for precision bolt tightening.
new_standard.materials: Forged chrome-vanadium steel / chrome-molybdenum steel ratchet head and tube, calibrated internal spring mechanism.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Torque range (5 Nm to 1500 Nm), torque accuracy (+/- 4% of indicated reading for mechanical / +/- 2% for digital), square drive dimensions per IS 6077 / ISO 1174, overload endurance without calibration shift (5000 cycles at maximum torque).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Prevents dangerous over-torquing (bolt snapping) and under-torquing (vibrational loosening) in critical aerospace, automotive wheel, and structural bolted joints.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Calibration verification against traceable torque transducer per ISO 6789-2, drop test, square drive torque proof test.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards MED 1 Hand Tools Committee
